name: Paranormal Buddies
source:
Hana is an ordinary girl with a dream out of the ordinary,  that is making PARANORMAL BUDDIES!!! 

And how to do that? Well with a "top" quality ouija board! 

And who will answer her questions? Well, of course you, player!

[From [url=https://christopher-laino-games.itch.io/paranormal-buddies]itch.io[/url]]
